title: Seller identity and complaints
description: Does the store say who sells (legal name, postal address, email address and the registration and tax numbers its markets ask for), and does it point to the right complaint channels?

title: Privacy notices and choices
description: Is a privacy notice linked from the home page, and does it name a privacy contact? Are the opt-out links and signals the store's markets ask for in place, and do trackers wait for consent?

title: Withdrawal, returns and cancellation
description: Can a consumer find how to withdraw, return or cancel: the EU withdrawal function, Argentina's withdrawal button, the legal minimum return period and an online cancellation route for subscriptions?

title: Accessibility
description: Is an accessibility statement linked, and do the pages read pass the accessibility basics a static scan can check? Automated checks find a minority of barriers and never show conformance.

title: Product and price information
description: Do product pages name the manufacturer with contact details? Do discounts show the lowest price of the last 30 days, are reviews explained, are environmental claims specific, and are Swiss prices in francs with VAT included?

title: AI transparency and content rights
description: Is an AI assistant on the site, is text and data mining reserved in a machine-readable way that does not also shut out shopping agents, and are AI-generated images marked?
